# Abstract

This submission consolidates every completed campaign-30 artifact into one self-contained theorem for m=2, p=147457, and d=87. Acceptance at least 3380076168821833/10^16 yields one total-degree-at-most-87 polynomial agreeing on more than 3674745607/108717834245 of the plane, hence at least 734949122 points. Its score is 7349491214, equal to the verified record, so it is intentionally not a leaderboard submission.

# Test and Notation

The test samples a uniform affine line and then a uniform point on it. There are 21743566849 points and 3206262880419842 incidences. The formal recovery requirement is max(174/147457,epsilon/10), with epsilon at least 957/1474570.

# Prior Results

Researchers 2 and 3 independently proved and received accepting audits for the C4-sharpened chain at the same score. Researcher 1 proved the incidence-lattice normalization used here. Researchers 4 and 5 supplied off-path algebraic and list-decoding modules.

# Theorem

The exact theorem is stated in theorem_statement and proved in P1-P10.

# Proof or Conditional Proof

Three-direction averaging, weighted interpolation, identity transfer, primitive cleanup, the exact C4 peeling credit, core survival, affine component mixing, simple-root reconstruction, and incidence-lattice normalization form a complete proved chain. The canonical note.md contains the full derivation and exact certificate.py replays every finite inequality.

# Soundness Ledger

The fixed charge is 769296828797543, the continuous survival frontier is 1244293905093223/3681259956715522, and the recovered component has density greater than 3674745607/108717834245. No loss is hidden in reconstruction or lattice conversion.

# Counterexample Attempts

The direction envelope and whole-relation derivative charge are locally sharp. The adjacent lower-s choice fails the current component certificate. The natural 3%-Johnson weak bridge is false.

# Characteristic Audit

The prime, derivative, Z-degree, discriminant, and root-count conditions are checked explicitly over F_147457.

# Limitations

No completed result lowers the absolute score below 7349491214. The present synthesis hash has not itself been independently audited, and the remaining modules do not close a strict improvement.
